WATCH │The Philippine Navy has successfully test-fired its Spike Non-Line-of-Sight (NLOS) missile system in a live-fire exercise off the coast of San Antonio, Zambales, marking a milestone in the military’s modernization efforts.

The drill featured the first-ever aerial launch of a Spike NLOS missile from the Navy’s AW159 anti-submarine warfare helicopter, which struck its designated target with precision. The BRP Tomas Campo (PG-908) also carried out a separate coordinated launch, demonstrating the missile’s surface strike capability. │Rex Espiritu
